findings.problem: The complete review found that the chapter’s extracted chronology relies on reign labels, retrospective table summaries, and institutional changes. These are valuable evidence but frequently do not establish an exact event date, personal lifespan, or activity across every year of an imperial reign.
findings.action: Retain all claims and hints as source-backed research holds. In a separate repair or approval round, verify each reign/calendar conversion and the owner and endpoint of every event; replace any unsupported whole-reign activity range only with a narrower verified date, one-sided bound, or explicitly contextual non-life representation.
